// fixture: record-extra-pixel-field. Fictional family Asha; not compiled, read by test/media-ast-scan.test.ts as text.
// as: apps/mobile/src/lib/media/asset-record.ts
// expect: record-field
type AssetRecord = { opaqueId: string };
export function toAssetRecord(raw: Record<string, unknown>): AssetRecord {
  return { opaqueId: String(raw.id), pixelSize: { width: 1, height: 1, dpi: 72 } };
}
